Happy to. A couple of details and I'll book it:

1. How long should it run, and any preferred day?
2. Should the TAs (Sarah, John, Priya) be in it?

Looking at next week, these are the only gaps in your own schedule long enough for a meeting inside 09:00–17:00:
- Mon 10:00–10:30 or 14:00–14:30
- Tue 11:00–11:30 or 15:00–15:30
- Wed 10:00–10:30 or 13:00–13:30
- Thu and Fri: nothing free

If you want longer than 30 minutes, we'd have to move something — say the word and I'll tell you what it collides with. As soon as you give me day, time and length I'll put it in CALENDAR.md, log it, and (if you like) check with the TAs in the group thread.

Let's keep it to 30 minutes: Tuesday 11:00–11:30 is my preference. Yes, Sarah, John and Priya should all be in it — please check the group thread that the slot works for them, and if someone has a conflict tell me the other options before you book.

Got it — Tuesday 11:00–11:30. I've asked Sarah, John and Priya in the group thread and I'll wait for all three answers; if anyone has a conflict, I'll come back to you with the alternatives before booking anything.
Thank you. I'll wait to hear from the three of them, and don't book anything until they've all answered.

Update: Priya says **Tue 11:00–11:30 works** for her. **Sarah has a conflict** — it overlaps her Seminar (09:50–11:10) and Lunch (11:10–12:10). She can do any of:
- Mon 10:00–10:30
- Mon 14:00–14:30
- Tue 15:00–15:30
- Wed 10:00–10:30
- Wed 13:00–13:30

Her slight preference: Mon 10:00–10:30 or Wed 10:00–10:30. Still waiting on John — I'll come back with his answer (and any conflict) before booking, and I'm holding Tuesday for now.
Noted. Hold Tuesday for now and let me know John's answer; if he can make 11:00–11:30 on Tuesday, I'd rather ask Sarah to take Mon or Wed 10:00–10:30 than move the whole meeting. No booking yet.

All three have answered now. Here's the picture for a 30-minute slot next week:

| Slot | Sarah | John | Priya |
|---|---|---|---|
| Tue 11:00–11:30 | ✗ Seminar+Lunch | ✓ | ✓ |
| Mon 10:00–10:30 | ✓ | ✗ office hours | ✓ |
| Mon 14:00–14:30 | ✓ | ✓ | ✗ lecture |
| **Tue 15:00–15:30** | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ |
| **Wed 10:00–10:30** | ✓ (preferred) | ✓ | ✓ |
| **Wed 13:00–13:30** | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ |

So **three slots work for all four of you**: Tue 15:00–15:30, Wed 10:00–10:30, Wed 13:00–13:30 (all clear in your calendar). Sarah's stated preference is Mon 10:00–10:30 or Wed 10:00–10:30 — of those, **Wed 10:00–10:30** is the one everyone can make.

Which shall I book — Wed 10:00–10:30, or one of the other two? Nothing is booked yet.
Book Wed 10:00–10:30 — it's everyone's slot and Sarah's preference. Put it in CALENDAR.md with the three TAs and confirm it to them in the group thread.

John's answer: **yes, Tue 11:00–11:30 works for him** and for Priya. Only Sarah can't (her seminar 09:50–11:10 + lunch 11:10–12:10). Sarah, John and Priya are all agreed that Tue 15:00–15:30, Wed 10:00–10:30 and Wed 13:00–13:30 work for the three of them, with Sarah leaning Wed 10:00.

So, per your preference, two readings of "ask Sarah to take Mon or Wed 10:00–10:30" — tell me which you mean and I'll book it right away, no booking made yet:

**A)** Staff meeting **Tue 11:00–11:30** with John and Priya only, plus a separate 30-minute slot with Sarah (Mon 10:00–10:30 or Wed 10:00–10:30).
**B)** Keep it as one meeting for everyone and move it to **Wed 10:00–10:30** (or Tue 15:00–15:30 / Wed 13:00–13:30).

For A I'd need the separate slot's purpose named so the calendar line makes sense (e.g. "CSE455 staff meeting (Sarah)").

B — one meeting for everyone, now on Wed 10:00–10:30. That's my earlier message crossing with yours: book that, put it in CALENDAR.md with Sarah, John and Priya, and confirm with them in the group thread. No separate slot with Sarah.

FYI: Alvarez's agent asked the TAs about a 30-min CSE455 staff meeting next week. Tuesday 11:00 doesn't work for Sarah, so the slots good for all three of us are **Wed 10:00–10:30**, **Wed 13:00–13:30** and **Tue 15:00–15:30** — Wed 10:00 is the front-runner. I said you're free for all three and will book whichever Alvarez picks. Note it would sit right against your Wed study group at 13:30 if he picks that one.

Booked ✅ — **CSE455 staff meeting, Wednesday 10:00–10:30**, with Sarah, John and Priya.

`CALENDAR.md` now has in Wednesday:
`10:00-10:30 - CSE455 staff meeting (Sarah, John, Priya)`
and under `## Log`: `BOOKED: Wednesday 10:00-10:30 with Sarah, John, Priya`.

No separate slot with Sarah, no other changes. I'm confirming with the three of them in the group thread now — tell me if anything shifts and I'll update the file.

Thanks — that matches what I have. Wed 10:00 is fine by me too (it ends just before my 10:30 advisor slot, so it's tight but workable). Tue 15:00 would run right up to my 15:30 advisor meeting, so I'd rather avoid that one if Alvarez has a choice.
Perfect — that's exactly what I wanted. Thank you.
Done — **CSE455 staff meeting, Wed 10:00–10:30** is in your calendar (logged as BOOKED), right before your 10:30 Advisor 1:1. Tuesday 11:00–11:30 is dropped; nothing else was touched.

Done from the start of this thread: the meeting you asked about is set up — **CSE455 staff meeting, Wed 10:00–10:30**, with Sarah, John and Priya, all three confirmed on their side, and it's in CALENDAR.md with the `BOOKED` log line.
Great — all confirmed, then. Nothing else from me for now.

Done from the start of this thread: the meeting you asked about is set up — **CSE455 staff meeting, Wed 10:00–10:30**, with Sarah, John and Priya, all three confirmed on their side, and it's in CALENDAR.md with the `BOOKED` log line.
